name: BIC Stake Bay Data Centre
notes: Stake Bay, Cayman Brac facility at 13 Stake Bay Rd; DataCenterMap lists site code BIC1, colocation/cloud services and operator Brac Informatics Centre. BIC official materials describe redundant Cayman data/disaster recovery centres on two islands.

name: Camana Bay Data Centre / BIC Camana Bay Data Centre
developer: Dart; Brac Informatics Centre listed as data-center operator/provider
notes: SOC II-certified Camana Bay colocation/data centre at 62 Forum Ln, George Town/Grand Cayman. Dart says the centre is staffed 24/7 with racks, redundant cooling and generators; DataCenterMap lists BIC Camana Bay Data Centre/BIC2 at the same address with about 4,421 sq ft and 40 colocation racks.

name: Azure Cayman - Central / SALT Azure Stack Cayman Islands
notes: SALT describes an on-island Microsoft Azure Stack cloud platform with Cayman Islands listed as an Azure Stack location and headquarters at 171A Elgin Ave, George Town. Cloudscene lists Azure Cayman - Central in George Town, operated by SALT.

name: C&W Business Cayman Islands Datacenter / Software Defined Data Center node
notes: C&W Business announcement says customers can consume resources from the Cayman Islands datacenter as part of its regional SDDC/VDC service. Liberty Business Cayman presence is headquartered at One Technology Square, Eastern Avenue, Grand Cayman; exact facility address/capacity not disclosed in public source.
